articles.summary: PHINIA Inc. (NYSE: PHIN), a leader in premium fuel systems, electrical systems and aftermarket solutions, announced today that it will participate in Bank of America’s 33rd Annual Industrials, Transportation and Airlines Key Leaders Conference on Wednesday, May 13, 2026. Conference participation will be in-person and include a QA session to discuss dynamics across the various markets PHINIA serves around the world and the Company’s business. PHINIA’s President and CEO, Brady Ericson, and Senior VP and ​CFO, Chris Gropp, will participate in the QA session with Bank of America’s equity research associate, Matt Palay. Matt covers U.S. Machinery, Engineering and Construction and Waste Management on Bank of America’s Industrial research team. Event information can be found below.
